description: This file defines an Angular component 'TreeComponent' used for rendering and interacting with a hierarchical tree structure in a UI. It handles node rendering, expansion/collapse, highlighting, and user interactions within a tree view.

classes.name: TreeComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying a hierarchical tree view with expand/collapse functionality, node selection, and styling.

methods.name: childTrackById
methods.description: Provides a trackBy function for ngFor to optimize rendering by tracking nodes via stableId or propertyKey.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the collapsed state of the tree nodes based on default settings.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles updates when input properties change, especially to emit selected node for highlights.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a node, toggling expansion or updating highlighted items.

methods.name: nodeOffsetStyle
methods.description: Calculates CSS styles for indentation based on node depth.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Emits an event to highlight a node based on its stableId.

methods.name: isPinned
methods.description: Checks if the current node is pinned based on pinnedItems.

methods.name: propagateNewHighlightedItem
methods.description: Emit event to update highlighted item.

methods.name: propagateNewPinnedItem
methods.description: Emit event to update pinned item.

methods.name: propagateNewSelectedTree
methods.description: Emit event to update selected tree node.

methods.name: isClickable
methods.description: Determines if node is clickable based on its leaf status and itemsClickable input.

methods.name: toggleTree
methods.description: Toggles collapse state of the node.

methods.name: expandTree
methods.description: Sets node to expanded state.

methods.name: isCollapsed
methods.description: Checks if the node is collapsed, considering global or local state.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns child nodes of the current node.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Determines if the current node has children and should display expand/collapse.

methods.name: setCollapseValue
methods.description: Sets the collapsed state, optionally updating global store.

methods.name: nodeMouseDownEventListener
methods.description: Handles mousedown events on node, preventing default double-click behavior.

methods.name: nodeMouseEnterEventListener
methods.description: Handles mouse enter event, setting hover state.

methods.name: nodeMouseLeaveEventListener
methods.description: Handles mouse leave event, clearing hover state.
